assets.prompt: Create a spectacular premium desktop wallpaper for a desktop theme called Candy Cloud. Landscape 16:9, ideally 3840 x 2160. Full bleed environment only: absolutely NO words, letters, logos, UI, windows, panels, dock, icons, frames or watermark. A luxurious pastel fantasy world, photoreal cinematic 3D environmental art with exquisite materials, not flat cartoon, not candy food. Floating alabaster islands, pink sakura-like trees, lush cushion clouds, pearlescent architecture, transparent iridescent ribbon pathways and thin luminous waterfalls. Sophisticated pink, peach, periwinkle, lilac and opal palette. Fine cloud detail, physically beautiful soft volumetric light, aerial perspective, sparkling pearly highlights. Wide composition with calm negative space through center for desktop windows. The three images in this series should feel like nearby districts in one cohesive beautiful world. This is SUGAR SKY, the left monitor scene. A spectacular tall floating terraced cloud garden at the LEFT edge, pink flowering trees and a small ivory pavilion atop it. A broad translucent pearlescent ribbon curls from near lower left up into the far center distance. Silky waterfalls pour into peach-tinted clouds below. Distant tiny floating islands towards the RIGHT, a tranquil luminous apricot sunset gradient sky, pale mauve cloud shadows. Detail concentrated in left third and bottom third, sweeping open sky in the middle. An airy dreamy panorama, soft warm afternoon, elegant not childish.
